interface.title: PixelMap – Neuropixels Channelmap Generator (v1.4.1)
interface.field: Systems neuroscience / extracellular electrophysiology (Neuropixels probes, SpikeGLX)
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment set-up before recording: choosing which recording sites the probe will use
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick which Neuropixels electrodes to record from on a clickable probe diagram that enforces the probe's shared-readout wiring constraints, optionally guided by an activity survey or atlas anatomy, then export the channel map as an .imro file (plus a PDF picture and a Kilosort JSON) for SpikeGLX.

data.note: Probe geometries and presets are built in. survey_2.0-4shanks.txt loaded as a heat-strip overlay. Of the .imro samples, only sample_2.0-1shank.imro was accepted, and it held just 3 sites. sample_1.0.imro and sample_2.0-4shanks.imro were rejected as corrupt because their entries had one field fewer than the parser expects. The anatomy overlay needs to download a brain atlas over the network, which failed here.

features.name: Constraint-aware site picker on a probe diagram
features.general: Pick items on a schematic of a device where choosing one item locks out others that share a resource. The schematic shows chosen, blocked and free items live, and keeps a running count against a fixed budget.
features.specific: Click electrodes on the shank plot, or drag a box. Picked sites turn red, sites sharing a readout line or ADC turn black, free ones stay grey, and the counter shows n/384 (or n/1536) until 'Ready for IMRO file generation'.
steps: click an electrode to toggle it
pick a drag-box tool (Select, Deselect, Zigzag, Interleaved)
drag a box over a stretch of shank
watch red, black and grey update and the counter fill
serves_tasks: Edit sites by hand on the diagram, zooming in where needed
Add sites by typing index ranges for one sub-unit

features.name: Free blocked items by releasing whatever blocks them
features.general: Select items you cannot currently pick; the tool finds the chosen items holding their shared resource and un-chooses those instead, wherever they are.
features.specific: Deselect Dependents tool: drag over black (blocked) electrodes. PixelMap deselects the red electrodes elsewhere that share their lines or ADCs, and the boxed sites turn grey.
steps: pick Deselect Dependents in the toolbar
drag a box over black sites
red sites on other shanks are deselected
the boxed sites become grey and selectable
serves_tasks: Edit sites by hand on the diagram, zooming in where needed

features.name: Patterned box selection
features.general: Drag a region and fill it with a fixed sparse pattern rather than every item, to cover more length at lower density.
features.specific: Zigzag-select (checkerboard, 0,3,4,7… on 2.0) and Interleaved-select (rows 0,1,4,5,8,9…) drag-box tools.
steps: pick the Zigzag or Interleaved tool
drag a box along a shank
only the pattern's sites inside the box are added
serves_tasks: Edit sites by hand on the diagram, zooming in where needed

features.name: Range-text selection per sub-unit
features.general: Add items by typing index ranges for one chosen sub-unit. Items that are blocked are skipped, and the selection stops at the budget.
features.specific: Shank selector + Electrode Selection ('0-47,96-120') + Add Electrodes to Selection.
steps: press Enter to commit the text
serves_tasks: Add sites by typing index ranges for one sub-unit

features.name: Preset layouts
features.general: Start from a named template configuration that is already valid for the chosen device.
features.specific: Preset dropdown (tips_all, gliding_0-3, zigzag_n, tip_b0_top_b1…) + Apply Preset; the list changes with the probe group.

features.name: Load an existing configuration file into the editor
features.general: Upload a previously saved device configuration and turn it into the current, editable selection, so an old layout can be reused or adjusted.
features.specific: Choose an .imro file and press Apply uploaded IMRO file to selection; entries with the wrong field count for the probe group are rejected as 'Corrupt .imro file'.
steps: choose the probe group the file was made for
press Apply uploaded IMRO file to selection
edit the loaded selection as usual
serves_tasks: Start instead from an existing configuration file

features.name: Measurement heat-strip overlay with colour limits
features.general: Load a per-item measurement file and draw it as a colour strip beside the layout, with an adjustable colour range, hover readout and fading of unavailable items, to steer the choice toward active regions.
features.specific: Survey overlay: load a SpikeGLX survey .txt; viridis strips flank each shank with a 'Survey value' colour bar; set vmin/vmax; the tooltip shows Survey value; strips fade where sites are blocked; Clear overlay removes it and keeps the selection.
steps: hover a site to read its value
serves_tasks: Show a per-site activity map beside the layout and choose where it is high

features.name: Edit history
features.general: Undo and redo whole edits (a drag counts as one step) and clear everything.
features.specific: ↶ Undo / ↷ Redo / Clear Selection buttons above the export panel.
steps: press Clear Selection to start over
serves_tasks: Step back and forward through edits

features.name: Budget-gated export bundle
features.general: Once the selection reaches its required size, name the output, pick the file-format version and download the machine config, a printable picture and a downstream-analysis map.
features.specific: At 384/384 the Select… buttons become IMRO ⬇, PDF ⬇ and Kilosort ⬇, using the filename field; 'Make legacy IMRO (SpikeGLX pre-20260115)' switches the IMRO format.
steps: fill the selection to the target count
serves_tasks: Name the finished configuration, pick the output format version and download it with companion files

features.name: State-in-URL share link
features.general: Encode the device choice and selection into a link that rebuilds them in a fresh session.
features.specific: Get shareable link writes ?cfg=… into the address bar, shows it in a box and copies it to the clipboard; opening it restores probe and selection, but not the legacy-IMRO tick or the filename.
steps: press Copy shareable link to clipboard
re-tick legacy IMRO and retype the filename if needed
serves_tasks: Share the layout as a link that rebuilds it

features.name: Probe trajectory entry for an atlas overlay
features.general: Enter where an instrument's tip sits and how it is angled, in either a fixed atlas frame or relative to a landmark, then compute which anatomical regions each part passes through.
features.specific: Anatomical overlay: Atlas dropdown, Tip AP/ML/DV, Pitch/Yaw/Shank ori, Tip relative to bregma (enables Bregma and squish/tilt fields), Compute anatomical overlay 🧠 (reads 'Download & compute atlas' while the atlas downloads).
steps: optionally tick Tip relative to bregma
serves_tasks: Place the instrument in an atlas by its tip position and angles to see which regions each part passes through (not reached: the atlas download needs a network connection)
